nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $G$ a group and $A$ a $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module on which $G$ acts by additive maps commuting with the $\mathbb{Z}_p$-action. For $g \in G$ and $\varphi$ in the algebraic $p$-adic Pontryagin dual of $A$, $g \cdot \varphi$ is the element $a \mapsto \varphi(g^{-1} a)$ of the dual.
nodes.title: Contragredient action on the $p$-adic Pontryagin dual

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and $A$ a $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module. If two elements $\varphi, \psi$ of the algebraic $p$-adic Pontryagin dual of $A$ satisfy $\varphi(a) = \psi(a)$ for every $a \in A$, then $\varphi = \psi$.
nodes.title: Extensionality for the $p$-adic Pontryagin dual

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and a $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module $A$, the algebraic $p$-adic Pontryagin dual of $A$ is the $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbb{Z}_p}(A, \mathbb{Q}_p/\mathbb{Z}_p)$ of all $\mathbb{Z}_p$-linear maps from $A$ to $\mathbb{Q}_p/\mathbb{Z}_p$; no topology or continuity condition is imposed.
nodes.title: Algebraic $p$-adic Pontryagin dual

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$, $\mathbb{Q}_p/\mathbb{Z}_p$ is the quotient of $\mathbb{Q}_p$, viewed as a $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module, by the image of $\mathbb{Z}_p$ under the canonical inclusion $\mathbb{Z}_p \to \mathbb{Q}_p$.
nodes.title: The quotient $\mathbb{Q}_p/\mathbb{Z}_p$

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and every $z \in \mathbb{Z}_p$, the quotient map $\mathbb{Q}_p \to \mathbb{Q}_p/\mathbb{Z}_p$ sends the image of $z$ in $\mathbb{Q}_p$ to $0$.
nodes.title: The quotient map vanishes on $\mathbb{Z}_p$

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$ and every $x \in \mathbb{Q}_p$, the quotient map $\mathbb{Q}_p \to \mathbb{Q}_p/\mathbb{Z}_p$ sends $x$ to its class $x + \mathbb{Z}_p$ in the quotient module.
nodes.title: The quotient map is the quotient projection

nodes.summary: For a prime $p$, this is the canonical projection $\mathbb{Q}_p \to \mathbb{Q}_p/\mathbb{Z}_p$, $x \mapsto x + \mathbb{Z}_p$, as a $\mathbb{Z}_p$-linear map.
nodes.title: The quotient map $\mathbb{Q}_p \to \mathbb{Q}_p/\mathbb{Z}_p$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $G$ a group and $A$ a $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module on which $G$ acts by additive maps commuting with the $\mathbb{Z}_p$-action. For $g \in G$, $\varphi$ in the algebraic $p$-adic Pontryagin dual of $A$ and $a \in A$, the contragredient action satisfies $(g \cdot \varphi)(a) = \varphi(g^{-1} a)$.
nodes.title: Evaluating the contragredient action

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
